item.title: Since 2004, the Doernbecher Freestyle initiative has worked with hundreds of kids to bring their stories to life through their own signature Nike shoe...
item.description:
Since 2004, the Doernbecher Freestyle initiative has worked with hundreds of kids to bring their stories to life through their own signature Nike shoes that will benefit their community.

For Year 22, six kids from the OHSU Doernbecher Children’s Hospital collaborated with Nike employee volunteers to create one-of-a-kind sneakers that are sold to benefit other kids just like them.

Owen’s passion for dirt biking shows up in the mud-splatter pattern that extends from the toe cap on his Air Max 1/97.

Aurora reimagined her Structure Plus as her own dream hotel in Japan. She chose a soft, faux fur on the collar representing carpets and a room key charm bracelet.

Royce competes in team bull roping, just like his parents. This family tradition is reflected in the braided laces; his favorite belt has been recreated on the ankle strap of his AF1 Mid.

Charlye’s ACG Rufus reflects her outdoorsy spirit and has a textured green swoosh that reminds her of moss. The UV-activated upper reveals a new color and hidden graphics.

Kamoryn’s GT Future has a color-fading pink and purple upper that he can see with his specific color-blindness. The goldfish details throughout nod to Kamoryn being under anesthesia post-surgery and seeing the animal swimming through the walls.

Avery’s Air Jordan 11 Low IE has a midsole full of characters Avery drew herself, representing all the cute aliens she designed, with a main character plushie she named “Greg.”

item.title: Nike Atelier for Sha’Carri Richardson reflects the beauty of London after rainfall through luminous details, weathered textures, and sculptural silho...
item.description:
Nike Atelier for Sha’Carri Richardson reflects the beauty of London after rainfall through luminous details, weathered textures, and sculptural silhouettes defined by strength and movement.

The bespoke look debuts on the red carpet at @athlos A26 in London.

Built to push beyond convention, the Nike FlyWeb bra uses computational design to engineer fit and support down to the millimeter. Precision-made for an athlete redefining power on and off the track.

The Nike Atelier Vomero Premium takes a performance silhouette into new territory, embellished with hand-set Swarovski® Crystals shimmering like water droplets above reflective Air Zoom units.

“You don’t have to choose one version of yourself. Every side of you can be powerful.”

Sha’Carri Richardson

Light and movement shape every detail of the Nike Atelier jacket, with hand-set Swarovski® Crystals that catch the light like raindrops across the reflective outer layer.

Made in Japan from premium crackled leather, the Nike Atelier Duffel Mini is accessorized with oversized custom charms that celebrate Sha’Carri’s connection to the track.

Nike Atelier. One of One.

item.title: Nike Atelier for Victor Wembanyama is shaped by instinct and precision, through a distinctly French lens.
item.description:
Nike Atelier for Victor Wembanyama is shaped by instinct and precision, through a distinctly French lens.

Football heritage, reimagined. Excellence, embodied.

Nike Atelier Total 90 is available for preorder July 20 at The Broken Arm (Paris), Dover Street Market (Paris), and SNKRS (North America).

The bespoke Nike Atelier LenoWoven jacket reinterprets performance innovation through an elevated lens, crafted from a cotton yarn adaptation of material technology originally developed for Nike Football boots.

At the intersection of world-class athletes, distinctive style, and pinnacle craftsmanship, Nike Atelier is made for the exceptional.

Inspired by the Total 90 Laser III, the Nike Atelier Total 90 distills one of Nike Football’s most iconic silhouettes into its purest form.

“My lifestyle influences my style, and comfort always comes first.” - Victor Wembanyama

Nike Atelier. One of One.
